sources.id_note_zh: 标识符刻意省略正式名称 DB11/T 2209-2023 中的斜杠，使 ID 保持纯字母数字与连字符；带斜杠的正式名称保存在 title 字段。
sources.id_note_en: The identifier deliberately drops the solidus from the published designation DB11/T 2209-2023 so the ID stays within a plain alphanumeric-and-hyphen character set; the published designation with its solidus is carried in the title field.
sources.not_cleared_reason_zh: 标准正文未以已清权形式存在于仓库。
sources.not_cleared_reason_en: The standard text does not exist in a cleared repository location.
sources.allowed_uses_zh: 仅确立该地方标准存在。
sources.allowed_uses_en: Establishes only that the local standard exists.
sources.prohibited_inferences_zh: 不确立适用性。D08 在具备资质的交通/慢行专业人员针对确切已清权版本与所引条款作出适用性记录前保持开放，相关路线、道路与过街成果同时挂起。
sources.prohibited_inferences_en: Does not establish applicability. D08 remains open until a competent mobility/transport professional records applicability against the exact cleared edition and cited clauses, with dependent route, road, and crossing artifacts held.
sources.limitations_zh: 在未持有已清权条文正文之前，标准记录只证明该标准存在及其施行日期。它不证明条款适用性、不产生标准派生尺寸，也不构成合规认定。
sources.limitations_en: Until the cleared clause text is held, a standard record establishes only that the standard exists and when it took effect. It does not establish clause applicability, does not yield a standards-derived dimension, and is not a compliance finding.
sources.usage: Registered to establish that the Beijing municipal local standard exists; it supports no applicability judgement and no road, crossing, or walking-and-cycling dimension.

sources.title: Beijing responsibility-planner instrument, 京规自发〔2024〕56号
sources.not_cleared_reason_zh: 文件正文未以已清权形式存在于仓库。
sources.not_cleared_reason_en: The instrument text does not exist in a cleared repository location.
sources.allowed_uses_zh: 仅确立责任规划师制度存在，可作为治理角色的制度语境。
sources.allowed_uses_en: Establishes only that the responsibility-planner instrument exists, as institutional context for a governance role.
sources.prohibited_inferences_zh: 不指定任何具名责任规划师，不授予本方案任何审批、实施或代表政府的权限。
sources.prohibited_inferences_en: Names no individual responsibility planner and grants this package no approval, implementation, or government-representation authority.
sources.limitations_zh: 官方公开文本只证明其自身发布了什么。它不提供正式边界 polygon、地块、权属、控制指标或实施授权；本包不从中推导任何未在其文本中出现的空间或数值结论。
sources.limitations_en: An official public text establishes only what it itself published. It supplies no official boundary polygon, parcel, tenure, control value, or implementation authority, and this package derives from it no spatial or numeric conclusion that does not appear in its own text.
sources.usage: Registered as evidence that a municipal responsibility-planner institution exists; it identifies no post-holder and confers no site remit.

sources.frozen_id_note_zh: 标识符由经批准的规范冻结；规范明确不选择出版机构、数据集、阈值或运行值，本次实施也不选择，因为没有任何仓库内证据能证实候选来源满足全部准入条件。记录以未选定状态登记，以保持 41 条计数契约，同时保留该未知。
sources.frozen_id_note_en: The identifier is frozen by the approved specification, which explicitly does not choose a publisher, dataset, threshold, or operational value. This implementation does not choose one either, because no repository evidence substantiates that any candidate source satisfies every admissibility condition. The record is registered in an unselected state so that the 41-record count contract holds while the unknown is preserved.
admissibility_conditions_zh: 公开可引用，由气象主管部门或官方开放数据集发布，且有稳定 URL；
发布资格判据实际使用的变量，标明台站或格点位置，并声明其与场地的关系为近似、未经测量。
admissibility_conditions_en: public and citable, published by a meteorological authority or as an official open dataset, and reachable at a stable URL;
publishes the actual variables the qualification criteria use, at a stated station or grid cell, whose location is stated and whose relationship to the site is declared approximate and non-surveyed.
sources.usage: No seasonal qualification criterion, threshold, or operating window may be derived from this record while selection_status is not_selected.
sources.limitations_zh: 该气象来源已登记但未被选用为证据；季节合格条件因此保持未确立，相关观察门保持开放。
sources.limitations_en: This meteorological source is registered but was not selected as evidence, so the seasonal qualification condition remains unestablished and the dependent observation gate stays open.
